name: Hotel Alpenpanorama
beschreibung: The Hotel Alpenpanorama occupies an elevated, sunny hillside location at Sonnbichl 18 above Söll in Tyrol's famed Wilder Kaiser holiday region. This distinguished four-star hotel features stylish rooms and suites crafted with natural timber in a contemporary alpine design, complete with elegant bathrooms, flat-screen TVs, free Wi-Fi, and private balconies boasting sweeping vistas of the towering Wilder Kaiser massif and the Hohe Salve. The extensive wellness sanctuary, featuring a panoramic Finnish sauna, herbal steam bath, infrared cabin, and bright relaxation lounges, provides deeply restorative rejuvenation. In the restaurant, guests savour bountiful gourmet breakfasts and multi-course evening dinners spotlighting regional Tyrolean products. The nearby ski bus whisks visitors to the base terminal of the expansive SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser–Brixental in minutes. In summer, scenic hiking trails start right at the door.
kurzbeschreibung: Four-star panoramic hotel on Sonnbichl in Söll at the Wilder Kaiser with Kaisergebirge views, wellness spa, and gourmet dining.
